description: Declare core + per-purpose extension groups once, then create and check VS Code profiles from that preset
config.title: Profile Kit
config.presetPath: Preset file (`*.profile-kit.json`) that declares core extensions, groups, profiles and settings. The same file is used in every profile. It is a path on this PC, so Settings Sync does not copy it to other PCs.
config.profile: Written by Profile Kit into each profile's own settings: the profile's name, so Profile Kit can tell which profile a window uses. Do not edit.
config.managedKeys: Written by Profile Kit into each profile's own settings: the keys it manages there, so it can update or remove only those. It is kept in the same file so it moves with Settings Sync. Do not edit.
view.welcome:
No preset file yet. A preset declares the extensions every profile gets (core), named groups, and profiles built from them.
[Open Preset File](command:profileKit.openPreset)
[Create Preset from This Profile](command:profileKit.createPreset)
